verdict.rationale: Morph is an API service, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no opt-out control, setting or flag for telemetry or usage tracking. The only related item is a community quote of the privacy policy saying training use differs by plan (free tier may train on code, enterprise does not). That is a tier-based data-use difference, not a user-facing opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
